sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Sarvesh Kumar Dubey Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State Respondents and Sri Sarvesh Kumar Dubey, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.4- National Highways Authority of India.

This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the opposite parties to realize/ recover the award from the private respondents and transfer the same to the petitioners in respect to his bhumidhari land of plot No.471 & 582 situated in Village- Paliya Shahbadi, Pargana- Haveli Awadh, Tehsil- Sadar, District- Panchram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23726735/
1 Ayodhya in the ends of justice."
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the property in question was initially recorded in the name of the father of the petitioner Late Mishri Lal.
After his death, the property was inherited by three brothers, namely, Sukai, Panchram and Santram along with their mother.
Sant Ram was minor and his brother Sukai was major.
Sukai sold off the share of the petitioner and Santram by way of a registered sale deed acting as guardian in the year 2010 and again in the year 2014.
Thereafter, the property has been transferred to other owners by way of sale deed.

The petitioner is a labourer eking out a living in Surat, Gujarat, and he came to know that the District Magistrate and other authorities have passed an Award with regard to the land in question for construction of National Highway, Faizabad/ Ayodhya to Raebareli.

The compensation has been given by the N.H.A.I. to persons on whose name the sale deed was made by the elder brother of the petitioner without the consent of the petitioner, therefore, the petitioner is entitled to recover the amount as given by Award declared by the Special Land Acquisition Officer from the subsequent purchaser.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the N.H.A.I. has submitted that N.H.A.I. deposits the compensation in the office of the Special Land Acquisition Officer, who disburses it on the basis of recorded tenure holder of the land acquired.

In the case of the petitioner, his brother may have played fraud upon him and his younger brother Santram, it would be appropriate for the petitioner to approach the competent Civil Court for declaration of such sale deed as void and for recovery of money either from his brother or from the subsequent purchaser.
The Writ Petition, for the prayer as drafted, is not maintainable.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Rahul  Panchram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23726735/
